verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions TPUs, Gaudi, or any other specialized accelerator. Hardware detection is documented only for NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs. The `--external-grpc-backends` option is a generic backend-loading mechanism, so it counts only as a developer building block that someone could use to construct accelerator support. It is not a documented TPU or Gaudi capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on specialized accelerators like TPUs or Gaudi through plugin support
